reconciliation.reason: The specialists (Data Steward to Research Librarian) and the manager plan are built around factor research for forward returns, so the R3_1 test selects TSK. Both retired labels map to Planning and Orchestration.

changes: dimensions: Control, Verification, and Feedback; Optimization and Evolution -> Interface and Interaction; Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: Frozen chronological splits, feature/label definitions and the held-out window govern information availability (R3_2). The validation-only feedback is a within-episode verification checkpoint, so it maps to Planning and Orchestration; it does not update reusable assets across episodes, so Optimization and Evolution is dropped.

Trailing-window and current-timestamp operator rules are temporal semantics that do not embed the decision-support objective; the grammar would be reused unchanged for another target, so the TSK counterfactual fails. The paper applies it only to factor forecasting, so reuse is inferred.

notes: Card omitted all Part II contributions (config-diff loop, hybrid predictor, threshold strategy) and the cross-run belief memory and falsification-driven evaluator, all stated as contributions in the paper; added as new modules. Card's retired seven-dimension labels are mapped per rubric. No LLM-side module: the work does not train or adapt a language model; the hybrid predictor is a non-LLM time-series model. The Visual Analyst event-profile step (L259-L260) is a one-paragraph description and is not counted as a separate module (blind pass listed it at low confidence). Layer of the manager pipeline and the sealed search are the main judgment calls. Part I and Part II IC values are not comparable (paper's own note). The walk-forward Sharpe of about 2.0 is a text value only.
